# AU Psychology Resources - Athabasca University

> Comprehensive online psychology learning platform offering interactive tutorials, research methods guides, and educational resources for distance education students.

Athabasca University's psychology department provides open educational resources covering research methodology, experimental design, biological psychology, and behavioral analysis. The site serves distance education students with interactive tutorials, APA citation guides, and specialized learning modules on foundational psychology concepts and influential researchers in the field.

## Key Topics

- APA Style Citation
- Experimental Design
- Research Methods
- Biological Psychology
- Behavioral Analysis
- Research Ethics
- Internal Validity
- Interactive Tutorials
- Distance Education
- Applied Behavior Analysis
- Neuroscience
- Educational Psychology
- Token Economies
- Precision Teaching

## Getting Started

- [AU Psychology Resources](https://psych.athabascau.ca/html/aupr/psycres.shtml): Central directory of psychology resources and student guides at Athabasca University
- [Online Glossary of Psychological Terms](https://psych.athabascau.ca/html/Glossary): Comprehensive glossary of psychology terminology for student reference

## APA Citation & Writing

- [Psychology - APA Style (7th Ed.) Tutorial](https://psych.athabascau.ca/open/apa7): Tutorial on APA 7th edition citation and formatting for psychology papers
- [Psychology - APA Style (6th Ed.) Tutorial](https://psych.athabascau.ca/open/apa6): Tutorial on APA 6th edition citation and formatting for psychology papers

## Research Methods & Design

- [Internal Validity Tutorial](https://psych.athabascau.ca/open/validity): Tutorial on internal validity and threats to validity in research design
- [Single-Factor Designs Tutorial](https://psych.athabascau.ca/open/singlefactor): Tutorial on single-factor experimental designs for PSYC 304 students
- [Factorial Designs Tutorial](https://psych.athabascau.ca/open/design): Tutorial on factorial experimental designs for research methods courses
- [Ethics Tutorial](https://psych.athabascau.ca/open/ethics): Interactive tutorial on research ethics and human participant protection

## Biological Psychology & Neuroscience

- [Introductory Biological Psychology Tutorials](https://psych.athabascau.ca/html/Psych289/Biotutorials): Interactive tutorials on brain anatomy and nervous system for Psychology 289
- [Advanced Biological Psychology Tutorials](https://psych.athabascau.ca/html/Psych402/Biotutorials): Advanced neuroscience tutorials on brain structures and neuroanatomy

## Behavioral Psychology & Learning

- [Positive Reinforcement Tutorial](https://psych.athabascau.ca/open/prtut): Interactive self-instructional tutorial on positive reinforcement concepts
- [Nathan Azrin and Token Economies](https://psych.athabascau.ca/open/azrin): Educational module on Nathan Azrin's work with token economies
- [Donald Baer and Applied Behavior Analysis](https://psych.athabascau.ca/open/baer): Educational guide on Donald Baer's contributions to applied behavior analysis
- [Direct Instruction - Englemann](https://psych.athabascau.ca/open/engelmann): Learning resource on Siegfried Engelmann's direct instruction methodology
- [Personalized System of Instruction](https://psych.athabascau.ca/open/keller): Course module on Fred Keller's personalized system of instruction
- [Ogden Lindsley and Precision Teaching](https://psych.athabascau.ca/open/lindsley): Learning resource on Ogden Lindsley's precision teaching methodology
- [Jack Michael and Verbal Behavior](https://psych.athabascau.ca/open/michael): Educational resource on Jack Michael's analysis of verbal behavior
